requirements.title: Ask for leave
requirements.statement: Staff ask for leave from their phone with leave type (Annual, Sick, Unpaid), from date, to date and reason.

requirements.title: Line manager decides
requirements.statement: The line manager approves or rejects each leave request; the employee is told the decision.

requirements.title: HR approval for long leave
requirements.statement: Leave longer than 5 working days also needs the HR Manager's approval, after the line manager.

requirements.title: Doctor's note
requirements.statement: Sick leave longer than 2 days needs a photo of the doctor's note on the request.

requirements.title: Team calendar
requirements.statement: Managers see a team calendar of who is off, to spot clashes before they approve.

requirements.title: Unpaid leave days to payroll
requirements.statement: Unpaid leave days reach Paystream Payroll by the 25th of each month without anyone retyping them; Paystream stays the payroll system.

requirements.title: Leave balance
requirements.statement: Each employee has a leave balance per leave type; approved leave takes the days off it. Annual leave is 25 days a year.

requirements.title: Working-day count
requirements.statement: The day count of a request works itself out: working days Monday to Friday, leaving out public holidays from a list the HR Manager keeps.

requirements.title: Submit a claim
requirements.statement: Staff submit an expense claim from their phone: date, category (Travel, Meals, Site materials), amount in euro, short description and a photo of the receipt.

requirements.title: Line manager decides
requirements.statement: The line manager approves or rejects each claim; the claimant is told either way.

requirements.title: Friday payment and Paid
requirements.statement: Accounts pays approved claims every Friday by bank transfer outside the system, then marks them Paid.

requirements.title: 60-day rule
requirements.statement: A claim for spending more than 60 days old is refused.

requirements.title: Monthly spend report
requirements.statement: A monthly report of spend by category for the Owner and Accounts.

requirements.title: Who sees what
requirements.statement: Staff see only their own leave and claims; line managers see their team's leave; the HR Manager sees all leave; Accounts sees all claims.

requirements.title: Training
requirements.statement: Neomenta trains the HR Manager and Accounts; they show the rest of the staff.

requirements.title: Support
requirements.statement: Standard Neome support; the HR Manager raises issues.
